sender.app_subtitle: Use your iMac as a display over a wired link.
sender.multi_session_hint: Each session uses its own local Thunderbolt IP and an independent stream to its target iMac.
sender.display_profiles.hint: Apply a ready-to-use setup. iMac ReVoyage remembers the last choice for this receiver.
sender.stream_hint_1: `Duplicate Desktop` creates a virtual monitor and mirrors the main display onto it. `Extended Desktop` creates a separate virtual monitor visible in Display Settings.
sender.stream_hint_2: `Smooth+` prioritizes motion. `Crisp` improves clarity. `5K` maximizes pixels.
sender.discovery_hint: Selecting a discovered receiver fills in the receiver IP automatically.
sender.mode_line_1: Panel size comes from the Receiver display
sender.mode_line_2: Virtual display follows the Receiver 1×/HiDPI scale
sender.mode_line_3: Pipeline: real virtual display (extended or mirrored) -> direct capture -> hardware codec -> TCP
sender.mode_line_4: The receiver switches to fullscreen only when the first frame arrives.
sender.mode_line_5: Choose the source, then balance motion and clarity with the stream profile.
sender.dock_icon.hint: While hidden, use the menu bar icon to open the main window or restore the Dock icon. The menu bar icon stays visible.
sender.toggle.prevent_display_sleep: Prevent screensaver / display sleep while streaming
sender.toggle.default_stream_audio: Enable audio by default for new sessions
sender.tooltip.top_bar: iMac ReVoyage - Software target display monitor
sender.error.screen_recording_permission: iMac ReVoyage does not have Screen Recording permission. Check Privacy & Security > Screen Recording.
sender.error.sck_permission_mismatch: ScreenCaptureKit failed even though Screen Recording permission appears granted. Details: %{details}
sender.diagnostics.guided_hint: Checks this Mac, the selected connection, receiver compatibility, and the permissions needed for the current input role.
sender.diagnostics.screen_recording_miss: Allow iMac ReVoyage under Privacy & Security > Screen Recording.
sender.diagnostics.local_link_missing: Choose an active local interface before connecting.
sender.diagnostics.thunderbolt_link_unex: Thunderbolt Bridge is selected, but %{interface} is not a bridge interface.
sender.diagnostics.network_link_selected: Network Link is selected on %{interface}; latency can vary.
sender.diagnostics.receiver_address_miss: Enter or select a receiver address.
sender.diagnostics.receiver_address_read: A receiver address is ready to use.
sender.diagnostics.receiver_profile_read: The receiver profile was received successfully.
sender.diagnostics.receiver_profile_pend: Connect once to read receiver compatibility and permissions.
sender.diagnostics.hevc_pending: Connect once to confirm HEVC support for the selected profile.
sender.diagnostics.hevc_ready: The receiver reports hardware HEVC decoding.
sender.diagnostics.hevc_missing: The receiver did not report hardware HEVC decoding; this profile may be slow or unavailable.
sender.diagnostics.cable_pending: Run Cable Test to measure this link before relying on 5K.
sender.diagnostics.input_monitoring_miss: Allow iMac ReVoyage under Privacy & Security > Input Monitoring.
sender.diagnostics.accessibility_missing: Allow iMac ReVoyage under Privacy & Security > Accessibility.
sender.diagnostics.receiver_permission_p: Connect once to read this permission from the receiver.
sender.diagnostics.permission_missing: Enable this permission in Privacy & Security on the receiver.

receiver.ui.title: IMAC REVOYAGE RECEIVER
receiver.ui.subtitle: Receiver ready for Sender
receiver.ui.help_1: Start the sender on your MacBook and enter this IP address.
receiver.ui.help_2: When the first frame arrives, the receiver switches to fullscreen automatically.
receiver.ui.help_3: If the sender stops, the receiver returns here ready for a new session.
receiver.ui.help_4: Press L to change the receiver language.

sender.input_bindings.title: Receiver shortcuts
sender.input_bindings.empty: No shortcuts yet. Add one to map a shortcut pressed on the receiver to an action on this Mac.
sender.input_bindings.details: Available when Receiver is Master. Trigger is pressed on the receiver; Action runs on this Mac. The trigger cannot be a macOS-reserved shortcut, such as Ctrl+Left for Spaces: use Ctrl+Option+Left instead. The action may use reserved shortcuts, including Ctrl+Left to switch this Mac's Space.
sender.pairing.scoped_hint: Enter the Receiver address and pairing code. Each address has a separate Keychain entry; save your old code again to bind it to this Receiver.
sender.video_protection.title: Video protection
sender.video_protection.hint: Shared interface budget: 80–300 Mbps per video session, plus 5 Mbps and 15% headroom. 900 Mbps is an initial estimate: enter verified available capacity. This does not throttle SMB or other apps.
sender.video_protection.invalid: Invalid capacity or insufficient for active sessions
sender.video_protection.background: Remaining theoretical budget: %{rate} Mbps (no system throttling)
sender.video_protection.budget_unavailab: Link budget unavailable: reduce the video preset, adjust link capacity, or stop the competing cable test.
sender.video_protection.configuration_to: Video configuration exceeds the protected link budget.
sender.uninstall.title: Uninstall
sender.uninstall.hint: Remove the app, pairing credentials, settings, caches and logs. Stored files are kept. Confirm in the next window.
sender.uninstall.helper_missing: The uninstaller is missing. Update or rebuild the app package.
receiver.uninstall.title: Uninstall
sender.media.title: iMac Camera & Microphone
sender.media.hint: Use the paired iMac camera and microphone in your calling apps. Install the virtual devices first.
sender.media.privacy: Capture starts only when enabled here. Allow access on the iMac; its menu bar offers Stop sharing. Disconnecting releases both devices.
sender.media.state.permission_pending: Allow camera or microphone access on the iMac.
sender.media.state.permission_denied: Access denied on the iMac. Check its privacy settings.
sender.media.state.device_missing: The selected iMac device is unavailable.
sender.media.state.device_busy: The iMac device is busy or cannot be opened.
sender.media.state.format_unsupported: This iMac device does not support the sharing format.
sender.media.state.capture_failed: Capture could not start on the iMac.
sender.media.state.camera_unavailable: Virtual camera unavailable. Install a signed camera extension first.
sender.media.state.microphone_unavailabl: Virtual microphone unavailable. Install the signed driver and restart macOS.
sender.media.state.connection_failed: Device connection closed or failed. Capture has stopped.
sender.media.state.connection_timeout: Device service timed out. Capture has stopped.
sender.media.state.invalid_media: Invalid media data. The connection was closed.
sender.media.devices.not_installed: Virtual devices require installation before use.
sender.media.devices.signing_required: This build has no Apple Developer team signature. Virtual device registration is unavailable.
sender.media.devices.move_to_application: Move Sender to /Applications before activating the camera.
sender.media.devices.approval_required: Allow the camera extension in macOS System Settings.
sender.media.devices.installed: Camera extension activated. Select ReVoyage — iMac Camera in your calling app.
sender.media.devices.restart_required: Restart macOS to finish the device operation.
sender.media.devices.install_failed: Device installation or removal failed. Check the macOS prompt.
sender.audio.send_failed: Audio send failed or exceeded the 150 ms backlog limit; reconnect the display.
sender.network.wired_required: Connect through Thunderbolt or wired Gigabit Ethernet; select the wired interface in the display session.
sender.network.link_too_slow: The wired link negotiated below 1 Gbps. Check the cable and adapter.
sender.media.state.wired_required: Connect through Thunderbolt or wired Gigabit Ethernet; select the wired interface in the display session.
sender.media.state.link_too_slow: The wired link negotiated below 1 Gbps. Check the cable and adapter.
sender.display_power.hint: Only the screen turns off; the iMac and background services keep running. Requires updated Receiver and HDMI Rescue.
sender.display_power.off_accepted: Display-off request completed; background services keep running.
sender.display_power.failed: Display power request was not confirmed. Check the HDMI Rescue service.
sender.display_power.rescue_hint: Transport loss latches Rescue Lock and keeps the screen awake, even without HDMI video. Manual display off/wake controls are next to each session’s brightness slider.
sender.brightness.unsupported: Backlight control unavailable on this display
sender.audio.driver_unavailable: Cannot read iMac speaker audio. Install the updated speaker driver and restart this Mac.
sender.audio.paused_congestion: Audio temporarily paused while its queue drains; it resumes automatically. Video continues.
sender.audio.queue: Audio queue: %{bytes} KB · %{packets} packets · oldest %{age} ms
sender.bandwidth.hint: Usable capacity per direction (default estimate: 900 Mbps on Gigabit). Link overhead is already excluded; each pool reserves 5 Mbps for control. Apply while display and media are disconnected.
sender.bandwidth.speaker: Speakers
sender.bandwidth.boundary: Video and camera use bounded packet bursts. Borrowing preserves audio/control shares; unused speaker/microphone shares stay reserved. PCM needs 2 Mbps per display session and 1 Mbps for the microphone. Disk/SD stay system-managed and may compete for bandwidth. Limits do not guarantee link speed.
sender.bandwidth.applied: Applied; used on the next connection
sender.bandwidth.rejected: Invalid quota or a session is still active
sender.media.state.bandwidth_unsupported: Receiver media service cannot apply this camera ceiling; update the Receiver

sender.pairing.steps: 1. Install Receiver on iMac  2. Import its pairing file  3. Return to the session and connect
sender.quality.hint: Starts at 1080p60 or 1440p30; sustained overload lowers resolution or frame rate. One recovery attempt after two stable minutes. Turn off to choose a fixed profile.
sender.diagnostics.screen_recording_pend: Permission check is inconclusive. Connecting will verify screen capture access.
sender.media.state.receiver_required: Choose an iMac or enter its address.
sender.receiver_update.title: Update Receiver remotely
sender.receiver_update.hint: Choose your iMac and the new full installation ZIP. Streaming pauses during the update and resumes afterward when possible.
sender.receiver_update.bootstrap: First use: install a version with remote updates on the iMac once. Future updates need no interaction on the iMac.
sender.receiver_update.installing: Updating iMac; keep the connection active…
sender.receiver_update.unavailable: Cannot reach the update service. Make sure the iMac has a version with remote updates and is logged in.
sender.receiver_update.wired_required: Connect the iMac using Thunderbolt or Gigabit Ethernet.
sender.receiver_update.invalid_package: Choose a full installation ZIP no larger than 96 MB.
sender.receiver_update.invalid_archive: The package is damaged or invalid. The current installation was preserved.
sender.receiver_update.incompatible_pack: The package lacks components or Intel / Catalina support. The current installation was preserved.
sender.receiver_update.installation_fail: Installation failed. Recovery of the previous installation was attempted; check the iMac update log.
sender.receiver_update.interrupted: The previous update was interrupted. Please retry.
sender.receiver_update.result_unknown: The result is not confirmed yet. Keep connected and use “Check update result” later.
sender.receiver_update.busy: The iMac is updating. Check the result shortly.
sender.receiver_update.invalid_request: Invalid update request. Please choose the package again.
sender.media.speaker_hint: After installation, restart this Mac and select ReVoyage — iMac Speakers in Sound output. Local speakers and headphones play only on this Mac.
sender.media.devices.speaker_restart_req: iMac speakers installed. Restart macOS, then select ReVoyage — iMac Speakers in Sound output.
